verses.text: LORD|strong="H3068" , my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.
Surely I have behaved and quieted myself, as a child that is weaned of his mother: my soul is* even as a weaned child.
Let Israel hope in the LORD|strong="H3068" from henceforth and for ever.
